name: elephant-mode
description: Elephants never forget: saves Claude Code's memory before it auto-compacts, compacts earlier, and shows a floating usage gauge. Local only, no network.

save_pct.title: Save memory at (% context)
save_pct.description: Context fullness at which Claude is told to save memory and continuity notes.

limit_pct.title: Save memory at (% usage limit)
limit_pct.description: 5-hour or weekly usage-limit level at which Claude saves memory before a possible cut-off.

context_window.title: Context window (tokens)
context_window.description: Used only when the statusline snapshot is unavailable. Auto-corrects upward if usage exceeds it.

backups.title: Back up transcripts before compaction
backups.description: Keep a local copy of the full conversation before each compaction. Off by default.

compact_pct.title: Auto-compact at (% context)
compact_pct.description: Written once to CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE on first run, only if you haven't set it yourself.

quiet.title: Quiet first run
quiet.description: Don't mention the first-run settings changes in the conversation.
